entities.name: John N. Irwin, II
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: John Nichol Irwin II was an American diplomat and attorney during the Cold War. During World War II, he served in the Army in the Pacific as a member of General Douglas MacArthur's staff and reached the rank of lieutenant colonel.
